optical_reference.note: BTS rise/fade are half-maximum timescales, not explosion-to-peak or diffusion times.

representation.training: full optical reference sample only, before IceCube temporal restriction

primary_test.source_statistic: max TS over identical Gaussian time kernels sigma=10,30,100 d centered at BTS observed peak
primary_test.population_statistic: k=10 nearest-neighbour hotspot in frozen PC1-PC2 space, excluding center source score

optical_stability.leave_one_subtype_out_note: SLSN-I has the largest geometric influence; hence an exclude-SLSN robustness branch is predefined.

negative_control.reason: apparent magnitude is not an IceCube exposure variable and differs intrinsically between Ia and SESN populations
